description_for_human: Project Schedule Generator Microsoft Project plan creation and editing.
description_for_model: For follow-up changes such as Add resources and assignments, reuse sessionId from the successful creation/download result; read affected entities and use edit tools, not the picker or new creation. Ask for unspecified resource/allocation decisions without losing the session. Re-select only a different file, an absent sessionId, or a session proven unavailable by a tool error. Route new schedule requests and their continuation replies to creation. Dates/work items supplied later continue the pending request. Ask only for missing scheduling inputs or estimate approval, never a save location or delivery choice. Once approved call create_project_schedule once without target, with parent-before-child tasks and parentTaskKey links, not a text-only WBS. Do not start with create_new_project_session. Only actual discovery/tool errors support capability limitations. Retain the returned sessionId for later edits. Always call open_project_plan_download as the final tool action of this turn; the user chooses OneDrive, SharePoint, or Download in its card. Report actual results; never print signed URLs or claim cloud saving merely because the card opened.
